title: Critical-degree base-change injectivity for arbitrary module coefficients
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, and $q\ge1$ an integer. Assume that $\mathrm{BC}(f,\Lambda,q-1)$ holds universally [sk-def-bc]. For any $a:S'\to S$, put $f':X'=X\times_SS'\to S'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $g:T\to S'$ be quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and let $e:Y=X'\times_{S'}T\to T$ and $h:Y\to X'$ be the projections. For a sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] write $b_F:(f')^{-1}R^qg_*F\to R^qh_*e^{-1}F$ for the base-change map [sk-def-bc]. Then (1) $b_F$ is a monomorphism for every $F$; (2) for every monomorphism $F\hookrightarrow G$, the induced map $\operatorname{Coker}(b_F)\to\operatorname{Coker}(b_G)$ is a monomorphism; (3) if moreover $G$ is injective, the coefficient map $R^qh_*e^{-1}F\to R^qh_*e^{-1}G$ kills the image of $b_F$ and induces a monomorphism $\operatorname{Coker}(b_F)\to R^qh_*e^{-1}G$. Kernels, cokernels and monomorphisms are taken in the abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ resp. $X'_{\mathrm{et}}$; injective means an injective object of the category of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$: maps of $\Lambda$-module sheaves into $G$ extend across every monomorphism of $\Lambda$-module sheaves [def-sp-enough-injectives]. No torsion or invertibility hypothesis on $\Lambda$ is imposed.

lean.statement:
theorem Etale.UniversalBaseChangeProperty.mono_baseChangeHomologyMap_and_cokernel {q : ℤ}
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (huniv : Etale.UniversalBaseChangeProperty Λ p (q - 1)) {S' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    {a : S' ⟶ S} {b : X' ⟶ X} {p' : X' ⟶ S'} (hp : IsPullback b p' p a) {g : T ⟶ S'}
    {h : Y ⟶ X'} [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g] (sq : IsPullback e h g p') :
    (∀ F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ),
      Mono (Etale.baseChangeHomologyMap Λ sq q F)) ∧
    (∀ {F G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)} (α : F ⟶ G) [Mono α],
      Mono (cokernel.map (Etale.baseChangeHomologyMap Λ sq q F)
        (Etale.baseChangeHomologyMap Λ sq q G) ((Etale.baseChangeSourceFunctor Λ p' g q).map α)
        ((Etale.baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ e h q).map α)
        (Etale.baseChangeHomologyMap_naturality Λ sq q α))) ∧
    (∀ {F G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)} (α : F ⟶ G) [Mono α]
      [Injective G],
      Mono (cokernel.desc (Etale.baseChangeHomologyMap Λ sq q F)
        ((Etale.baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ e h q).map α)
        (Etale.baseChangeHomologyMap_comp_map_eq_zero_of_injective Λ sq (by lia) α)))
lean.note: Exact existing arbitrary-commutative-ring version at CriticalMap.lean:204–223, also confirmed by scompile.py --source. Its three conjuncts give (1) the monomorphism for every coefficient sheaf, (2) the natural cokernel monomorphism for every coefficient monomorphism, and (3) the cokernel-desc monomorphism into the higher direct image for injective G. The proof argument to cokernel.desc is baseChangeHomologyMap_comp_map_eq_zero_of_injective, which supplies the stated vanishing of the coefficient composite. The section parameters are an arbitrary commutative Λ, schemes and scheme morphisms; there is no torsion or invertibility hypothesis. IsPullback encodes the two fibre products without choosing special representatives.
